entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex. I'm calling about an order I received last week. I need to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's more of a fit and preference issue. I've used them a couple of times, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heels. They just don't seem to be the right shape for my foot.

I'm sorry to hear that the shoes are causing discomfort. Blisters are definitely not what we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your order number or the email address you used?

Thank you. I see your order right here. You received the cycling shoes 9 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window, so I can absolutely process that for you for a full refund.

Okay, a full refund is great. I appreciate that. Now, since I have to go through the trouble of packing these up and shipping them back, is there any chance you could offer a small discount code for my next purchase? I still need a pair of shoes, just a different model.

I understand you're looking for a replacement pair. While I can't add a discount code on top of the full refund, I can assure you the return process is straightforward. I'm sending the pre-paid return label to your email now. Just be sure to remove any personal cleats you may have attached before you pack them up.
Alright, I thought it was worth asking. A full refund is fair enough. I'll look for that email.

Perfect. You should see that in your inbox within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
